source: reused from chess_blunder_taxonomy_v2 (k16) — coaching vocab is checkpoint-independent

categories.name: Ignoring Threats
categories.definition: Failing to address the opponent's immediate tactical threats, hanging pieces, mating ideas, or intermediate moves.

categories.name: Slow Play Punished
categories.definition: Non-urgent, passive, or prophylactic moves when the position demands immediate tactical action or concrete play.

categories.name: Moving Hangs Pieces
categories.definition: A move that inadvertently leaves another own piece unprotected, creating a free capture for the opponent.

categories.name: Piece Abandons Defense
categories.definition: Moving a piece away from a square where it performed a critical defensive duty, allowing the opponent's threats to succeed.

categories.name: Pieces Left Undefended
categories.definition: Placing or leaving pieces on squares without adequate protection, making them vulnerable to capture.

categories.name: Rook Misplacement
categories.definition: Rook moves that abandon key files, ranks, or defensive posts, often ignoring tactical obligations.

categories.name: Passed Pawn Blindness
categories.definition: Failing to stop, advance, or properly handle dangerous passed pawns, including promotion oversights.

categories.name: Pawn Moves Weaken King
categories.definition: Pawn advances that compromise the king's pawn shelter, open critical files or diagonals, or expose the king to attack.

categories.name: Captures Backfire
categories.definition: Exchanges or recaptures that activate the opponent's pieces, release tension, or create new tactical vulnerabilities.

categories.name: Pawn Moves Ignore Threats
categories.definition: Pawn pushes made when urgent tactical emergencies or piece safety issues demand immediate attention.

categories.name: Piece Lands Badly
categories.definition: Developing or repositioning pieces to tactically vulnerable, attacked, or overloaded squares that invite punishment.

categories.name: Checks Lose Tempo
categories.definition: Giving checks or desperado moves that accomplish nothing strategically and waste critical time.

categories.name: Greedy Captures
categories.definition: Material grabs that ignore tactical consequences, positional damage, or allow the opponent dangerous counterplay.

categories.name: King Safety Ignored
categories.definition: Prioritizing material gain, piece activity, or development while neglecting the king's need for protection.

categories.name: Retreating Errors
categories.definition: Piece retreats that lose tempo, walk into greater danger, or allow the opponent to advance with initiative.

categories.name: King Walks Into Danger
categories.definition: King moves that step into checks, mating nets, knight forks, discovered attacks, or lose critical opposition.

categories.name: Fork Vulnerability
categories.definition: Moving pieces into positions where they become vulnerable to forks, discovered attacks, or overloading tactics.

categories.name: Piece Trapping
categories.definition: Moves that result in own pieces becoming trapped, blocked, or unable to escape capture.

categories.name: Unsound Sacrifices
categories.definition: Incorrect piece sacrifices that do not generate sufficient compensation in attack or material recovery.

categories.name: Back Rank Weakness
categories.definition: Overlooking or creating back rank mate vulnerabilities by leaving the king trapped behind its own pieces.
